name: Salmon-Bell Pepper Skewers with Grilled Bok Choy & Cauliflower Rice

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 4-6 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium head cauliflower
1 (2 ½ cm) piece ginger root
3 baby bok choy
1 red bell pepper
½ avocado

instructions.primary_message: Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl.
Add oil and salt to the bowl with the cauliflower rice, then stir to combine. Transfer to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until cauliflower rice is tender and golden, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in the reserved bowl along with oil, soy sauce, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp honey
¼ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp crushed red pepper
¼ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and large dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl with the marinade.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl, gently stir to coat, and set aside.

Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat. While the pan heats up, using a clean cutting board, trim and cut bok choy in half lengthwise; place on a plate. Drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp toasted sesame oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, add bok choy, cut-side down, and grill, flipping once, until tender and charred, 4-5 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pan for later use.)

Meanwhile, thread salmon and bell pepper onto the skewers, alternating ingredients; place on another plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the salmon and bell pepper directly on the grill pan.)
Return pan to medium-high heat, add skewers and grill, turning every 1 ½-2 minutes, until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to the plate with the bok choy.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice, bok choy, skewers, and avocado between plates. Sprinkle skewers with sesame seeds and enjoy!
